entries.title: What a settlement is
entries.simple_en: A settlement is when Razorpay sends the money your customers paid to your bank account. Razorpay takes out its service fees first, then sends you the rest.
entries.simple_hi: Settlement वह प्रक्रिया है जहाँ Razorpay आपके ग्राहकों द्वारा दिए गए पैसे को आपके बैंक खाते में भेजता है। पहले Razorpay अपना सेवा शुल्क निकालता है, फिर बाकी पैसे आपको भेजता है।
entries.simple_hinglish: Settlement matlab jo paisa aapke customers ne diya hai wo Razorpay aapke bank account mein bhej deta hai. Pehle apna fee nikaal leta hai, phir baaki paisa aapko bhej deta hai.

entries.title: Settlement cycle: T+2 working days
entries.simple_en: Your payment settles to your bank account within 2 business days after the payment is captured. Weekends and bank holidays do not count.
entries.simple_hi: आपका पेमेंट capture होने के 2 कार्यदिवसों के भीतर आपके बैंक खाते में जमा हो जाता है। सप्ताहांत और बैंक की छुट्टियाँ गिनी नहीं जाती।
entries.simple_hinglish: T+2 din mein settlement ho jata hai. T matlab jo din payment capture hua, uske baad 2 business days. Weekends aur bank holidays count nahi hote.

entries.title: What is subtracted from settlement
entries.simple_en: Razorpay subtracts service fees, taxes, any refunds you gave, and disputed charges from your settlement amount. The rest is credited to your bank.
entries.simple_hi: Razorpay आपके settlement से सेवा शुल्क, कर, आपके द्वारा दिए गए रिफंड, और विवादास्पद शुल्क निकालता है। बाकी आपके बैंक खाते में जमा होता है।
entries.simple_hinglish: Settlement se Razorpay apna fee, tax, refund, aur dispute nikaal leta hai. Baaki amount aapke bank mein chala jata hai.

entries.title: Instant (on-demand) settlements
entries.simple_en: You can withdraw your money instantly any time using on-demand settlement, but you pay a small fee. The money arrives in minutes instead of waiting T+2 days.
entries.simple_hi: आप अपने पैसे तुरंत निकाल सकते हैं on-demand settlement से, पर एक छोटा सा फीस देना होगा। पैसे मिनटों में आ जाते हैं, T+2 दिन इंतज़ार नहीं करना पड़ता।
entries.simple_hinglish: Instant settlement mein aap kisi bhi time apne paise nikaal sakte ho. Chhota sa fee lagta hai par paisa turant aa jata hai. T+2 days intezaar nahi karna padta.

entries.title: Payment status lifecycle
entries.simple_en: A payment starts as created, then becomes authorized (customer's bank confirmed), then captured (confirmed payment). After capture, it eventually settles to your bank. If not captured within 5 days, the money returns to the customer.
entries.simple_hi: एक पेमेंट 'created' से शुरू होता है, फिर 'authorized' बन जाता है (ग्राहक के बैंक ने पुष्टि की), फिर 'captured' होता है। Capture के बाद settlement होता है। अगर 5 दिनों में capture नहीं हुआ, तो पैसे ग्राहक को वापस चले जाते हैं।
entries.simple_hinglish: Payment pehle 'created' hota hai, phir 'authorized' (customer ke bank ne confirm kiya), phir 'captured' hota hai. Capture ke baad settlement hota hai. Agar 5 din mein capture nahi hua to paisa customer ko wapas chala jata hai.

entries.title: What if payment is authorized but not captured
entries.simple_en: If a payment stays authorized but is not captured within 5 days, the customer's money automatically returns to their card or account.
entries.simple_hi: अगर पेमेंट authorized तो रहता है लेकिन 5 दिनों के अंदर captured नहीं होता, तो ग्राहक का पैसा अपने आप वापस आ जाता है।
entries.simple_hinglish: Agar payment authorized rahta hai lekin 5 din mein capture nahi hua, to customer ka paisa apne aap wapas aa jata hai.

entries.title: What does 'failed payment' mean
entries.simple_en: A failed payment means the customer's payment could not be completed. The reasons can be: the customer made a mistake (wrong OTP, invalid card), your setup has a problem, the bank is down, or an issue with Razorpay.
entries.simple_hi: Failed payment का मतलब है ग्राहक का पेमेंट पूरा नहीं हो सका। कारण हो सकते हैं: ग्राहक की गलती (गलत OTP, invalid card), आपके setup में problem, बैंक down है, या Razorpay में issue है।
entries.simple_hinglish: Failed payment matlab customer ka payment pura nahi ho saka. Karan ho sakte hain: customer ki galti (galat OTP, invalid card), aapke setup mein problem, bank down hai, ya Razorpay mein issue hai.

entries.title: Money left account but payment failed
entries.simple_en: If a customer's money leaves their account but the bank doesn't send a confirmation, the money automatically returns within 7 business days. You don't need to do anything.
entries.simple_hi: अगर ग्राहक के account से पैसा निकल गया लेकिन बैंक ने पुष्टि नहीं की, तो पैसा 7 कार्यदिवसों के अंदर अपने आप वापस आ जाता है। आपको कुछ नहीं करना है।
entries.simple_hinglish: Agar customer ke account se paisa nikla lekin bank ne confirm nahi kiya, to 7 din mein paisa apne aap wapas aa jata hai. Aapko kuch nahi karna hai.

entries.title: What is a refund
entries.simple_en: A refund is when you send a customer's money back to them. You can refund the full amount or just part of it. Refunds go back to the customer's account or card.
entries.simple_hi: Refund वह है जब आप ग्राहक का पैसा वापस भेजते हैं। आप पूरी रकम या सिर्फ कुछ हिस्सा refund कर सकते हैं।
entries.simple_hinglish: Refund matlab aap customer ka paisa wapas dete ho. Poora paisa ya aadha paisa, jo chahe. Paisa customer ke account mein aa jata hai.

entries.title: Full refund vs partial refund
entries.simple_en: A full refund returns the entire payment amount to the customer. A partial refund returns only part of it. You decide the amount.
entries.simple_hi: Full refund में आप सारा पैसा ग्राहक को वापस देते हो। Partial refund में सिर्फ कुछ हिस्सा देते हो। अमाउंट आप तय करते हो।
entries.simple_hinglish: Full refund = sara paisa wapas. Partial refund = aadha ya kuch hissa wapas. Amount aap decide karte ho.

entries.title: How long does a refund take
entries.simple_en: Normal refunds take 5 to 7 business days to reach the customer's card or bank account. During this time, the refund status shows as 'pending'.
entries.simple_hi: सामान्य refund 5 से 7 कार्यदिवसों में ग्राहक के account या card में पहुंच जाता है। इस समय refund status 'pending' दिखता है।
entries.simple_hinglish: Normal refund 5-7 din mein customer ke account mein aa jata hai. Tab tak status 'pending' dikhai deta hai.

entries.title: Refund vs Reversal: what's the difference
entries.simple_en: A refund is when you give back a customer's payment on purpose. A reversal is when a customer or their bank cancels a payment without permission (like a chargeback). Reversals cost money and hurt your reputation.
entries.simple_hi: Refund वह है जब आप जानबूझकर ग्राहक को पैसा वापस देते हैं। Reversal तब होता है जब ग्राहक या बैंक बिना अनुमति के payment रद्द कर देता है (जैसे chargeback)। Reversals से नुकसान होता है।
entries.simple_hinglish: Refund = tum dete ho. Reversal = customer ya bank bina permission ke paisa wapas le leta hai (chargeback ki tarah). Reversal se nuksan hota hai.

entries.title: Do Razorpay fees come back with a refund
entries.simple_en: No. When you refund a customer, Razorpay's service fees are not returned to you. You keep paying the fee even though you gave the money back.
entries.simple_hi: नहीं। जब आप ग्राहक को refund देते हैं, तो Razorpay का service fee आपको वापस नहीं मिलता। Fee आप को देना ही पड़ता है भले ही पैसा वापस दे दिया।
entries.simple_hinglish: Nahi. Refund dene ke baad bhi Razorpay ka fee aapko nahi milta. Fee aap hi dete ho.

entries.title: Instant refund vs normal refund
entries.simple_en: Normal refunds are free and take 5-7 days. Instant refunds charge a small fee but reach the customer in a few hours instead.
entries.simple_hi: Normal refunds free हैं और 5-7 दिन लगते हैं। Instant refunds में fee लगता है पर कुछ घंटों में पैसा पहुंच जाता है।
entries.simple_hinglish: Normal refund = free, 5-7 din. Instant refund = fee lagta hai par paisa turant aa jata hai.

entries.title: What is a Payment Link
entries.simple_en: A Payment Link is a unique URL you create and send to a customer so they can pay you. Each link is one-time only, not for repeat customers. If you want repeat payments, use Subscriptions instead.
entries.simple_hi: Payment Link एक unique URL है जो आप बनाते हैं और ग्राहक को भेजते हैं ताकि वह आपको pay कर सके। यह एक बार ही काम करता है।
entries.simple_hinglish: Payment Link = unique link jo aap create karte ho. Customer ko bhej dete ho, wo click karke payment de deta hai. Ek baar ka link hai.

entries.title: What fields are required for a Payment Link
entries.simple_en: You only need to specify the amount (how much the customer should pay). Customer name, email, phone, and other details are all optional.
entries.simple_hi: आपको सिर्फ amount बताना है (कितना pay करना है)। Customer का नाम, email, phone सब optional है।
entries.simple_hinglish: Sirf amount zaroori hai. Customer ka naam, email, phone sab optional hai.

entries.title: Payment Link expiry
entries.simple_en: You can set when a Payment Link expires. After the expiry date and time, the customer cannot use the link to pay.
entries.simple_hi: आप set कर सकते हैं कि Payment Link कब expire हो जाए। Expiry के बाद ग्राहक उस link से pay नहीं कर सकता।
entries.simple_hinglish: Aap set kar sakte ho ki link kab expire ho jaye. Uske baad customer use nahi kar sakta.

entries.title: Send Payment Link to customer
entries.simple_en: You can send the Payment Link to your customer via email or SMS. You need to enter their email address or phone number.
entries.simple_hi: आप Payment Link को ग्राहक को email या SMS से भेज सकते हैं। Email या phone number देना ज़रूरी है।
entries.simple_hinglish: Aap link email ya SMS se customer ko bhej sakte ho. Email ya phone number dalna padega.

entries.title: Payment Link statuses
entries.simple_en: A Payment Link can be: paid (customer has already paid), cancelled (you cancelled it), expired (time ran out), or partially paid (if you allow part-payments).
entries.simple_hi: Payment Link की status हो सकती है: paid (ग्राहक ने pay कर दिया), cancelled (आपने रद्द कर दिया), expired (समय खत्म हो गया), या partially paid।
entries.simple_hinglish: Link status: paid (customer ne pay kar diya), cancelled (aapne cancel kiya), expired (time khatam), ya partially paid.

entries.title: Razorpay service fees
entries.simple_en: Razorpay charges a fee on each payment. The exact percentage depends on your account type and payment method. Check your account dashboard or contact Razorpay support for your fee rate.
entries.simple_hi: Razorpay हर payment पर fee लेता है। सटीक प्रतिशत आपके account type और payment method पर निर्भर करता है। अपना fee rate जानने के लिए अपने dashboard को check करें।
entries.simple_hinglish: Razorpay har payment par fee leta hai. Exact percentage aapke account type par depend karta hai. Apne dashboard mein check karo.

entries.title: GST (tax) on fees
entries.simple_en: Razorpay adds 18% GST (tax) on top of its fees. This applies to almost all payments except domestic card payments under ₹2,000.
entries.simple_hi: Razorpay अपने fee के ऊपर 18% GST (tax) लगाता है। यह लगभग सभी payments पर लागू होता है, सिवाय domestic card payments जो ₹2,000 से कम हों।
entries.simple_hinglish: Razorpay 18% GST lagata hai fee par. Almost sab payments par, sirf chhote card payments par nahi (₹2000 se kam).

entries.title: Settlement amount = Payment - Fees - Tax
entries.simple_en: The amount you receive in settlement = Total payment money - Razorpay fees - GST tax on fees. This is what lands in your bank account.
entries.simple_hi: Settlement amount = कुल payment - Razorpay fees - GST tax। यही अमाउंट आपके bank account में जाता है।
entries.simple_hinglish: Settlement = Total payment - fee - tax. Yahi amount aapke bank mein aata hai.

entries.title: Types of reports available
entries.simple_en: You can download three types of reports: Payments (all your transactions), Settlements (money sent to your bank), and Settlement Reconciliation (comparing your records with Razorpay's).
entries.simple_hi: आप तीन तरह की reports download कर सकते हैं: Payments, Settlements, और Settlement Reconciliation।
entries.simple_hinglish: Teen types ki reports: Payments (sab transactions), Settlements (bank mein aaya paisa), Settlement Reconciliation.

entries.title: Report file formats
entries.simple_en: You can download reports as CSV, XLS, or XLSX files. These are spreadsheet formats you can open in Excel or Google Sheets.
entries.simple_hi: Reports को CSV, XLS, या XLSX format में download कर सकते हैं। ये spreadsheet files हैं जो Excel में खुलती हैं।
entries.simple_hinglish: CSV, XLS, ya XLSX format mein download kar sakte ho. Ye Excel mein kul sakte ho.

entries.title: Auto-scheduled report delivery
entries.simple_en: You can ask Razorpay to automatically email reports to you on a schedule: daily, weekly, or monthly. You choose the frequency.
entries.simple_hi: आप Razorpay को कह सकते हैं कि reports आपको automatically email करें: daily, weekly, या monthly।
entries.simple_hinglish: Reports apne aap email ho sakte hain: daily, weekly, ya monthly. Aap choose karte ho.

entries.title: Custom date range for reports
entries.simple_en: When downloading a report, you can select any date range you want (a specific day, month, or any time frame).
entries.simple_hi: Report download करते समय आप कोई भी date range चुन सकते हैं।
entries.simple_hinglish: Report ke liye koi bhi date range select kar sakte ho. Jo chahe vo date.

entries.title: What is a dispute
entries.simple_en: A dispute is when a customer or their bank says 'this payment should not have happened.' It can be because of fraud, undelivered goods, or wrong billing.
entries.simple_hi: Dispute तब होता है जब ग्राहक या बैंक कहता है 'यह payment नहीं होना चाहिए था।' Fraud, goods न देने, या गलत billing की वजह से।
entries.simple_hinglish: Dispute matlab customer ya bank kahta hai payment galat tha. Fraud, goods nahi mile, ya galat bill.

entries.title: Dispute escalation phases
entries.simple_en: A dispute starts as Fraud, then becomes Retrieval (soft chargeback), then Chargeback, then Pre-Arbitration, finally Arbitration. Early phases are easier to win; later phases are expensive to fight.
entries.simple_hi: Dispute के phases: Fraud → Retrieval → Chargeback → Pre-Arbitration → Arbitration। शुरू के phases आसान हैं; आखिरी phases बहुत महंगे।
entries.simple_hinglish: Dispute phases: Fraud, Retrieval, Chargeback, Pre-Arbitration, Arbitration. Shuru mein easy, aakhir mein mehenga.

entries.title: Dispute statuses
entries.simple_en: A dispute status progresses: Open (just started) → Under Review (being checked) → Won/Lost (decided) or Closed (fraud resolved).
entries.simple_hi: Dispute status: Open (शुरू) → Under Review (check हो रहा है) → Won/Lost (तय हो गया) या Closed।
entries.simple_hinglish: Dispute status: Open, Under Review, Won, Lost, ya Closed. Shuru se aakhir tak.

entries.title: How to respond to a dispute
entries.simple_en: You have two options: accept the dispute (refund the customer) or contest it (submit proof the payment was valid, like delivery confirmation or receipt).
entries.simple_hi: दो विकल्प: dispute को accept करो (refund दो) या contest करो (proof दो कि payment valid थी)।
entries.simple_hinglish: Do option: accept karo (refund dedo) ya fight karo (evidence dedo).

entries.title: International payment settlement timeline
entries.simple_en: International payments settle slower than domestic ones. They take about 7 business days instead of 2.
entries.simple_hi: International payments domestic से ज़्यादा समय लेते हैं। लगभग 7 कार्यदिवस लगते हैं, 2 की बजाय।
entries.simple_hinglish: International payment T+7 din mein settle hota hai. Domestic se zyada time.
